senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (गलति)
1 To eat.
2 To ooze;
also (ङ्) गलङ् r. 10th cl. (गलयते)
To drop, to ooze or distil.
With अव prefixed,
To fall, to fall down or off;
With वि,
1 To go, to approach.
2 To bear or support.

m. (-लः)
1 The throat.
2 The resin of the Sal tree.
3 A reed, a large kind of the Saccharum cylindricum.
4 A rope.
5 A musical instrument.
6 A kind of fish, a small kind of cyprinus, a subgenus of that class, (Cyprinus garra, HAM.)
E.
गल to eat, to drop, &c. affix अच्, or गॄ to swallow, with अच्, गर, and र changed to ल.

m. (-ल्लः)
The cheek.
E.
गल to eat, and ल affix; from ला to get or receive.

m. (-लः)
1 Flowing, liquefying.
2 Flowing, dropping.
3 A flux.
E.
गल to flow, घञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
A kind of fish.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-लः)
A bull's dewlap.
E.
गल the neck, and कम्बल a soft substance as a blanket, &c.

m. (-ण्डः)
Inflammation, enlargement of the glands of the neck.
E.
गल the throat, and गण्ड a swelling or boil.

m. (-हः)
1 A sauce of fish ground up with salt, pepper, Ghee, &c.
2 A day on which a course of study is commenced, but immediately preceding a day on which study is prohibited.
3 The fourth lunation of the dark fortnight, the seventh, eighth, and ninth, the thirteenth and three days following.
4 Seizing any one by the throat, throttling, choking^1.
E.
गल the throat, and ग्रह what takes, &c.; also गलग्रहण.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्)
1 Falling, dropping.
2 Oozing, trickling, flowing.
3 Melting.
E.
गल to flow, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
Melting, fusing.
2 Trickling, dropping, oozing.
3 Falling down or off.
4 Leaking.
E.
गल to drop, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Straining fluids.
2 Fusing, liquefying, &c.
E.
गल् to flow, causal form, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Fusible, liquefiable, to be melted, &c.
E.
गल to melt, अनीयर् affix; also गलितव्य and गल्य.

f. (-का)
1 A small pitcher.
2 A small water jar with a small hole in the bottom, from which the water drops upon a Liṅga or Tulasi plant, placed beneath.
E.
गड to drop, affix झच्, गडन्ति; कन् in the fem. form added, and ड changed to ल.

f. (-ला)
A thread worn round the neck, a necklace.
E.
गल the throat, and मेखला a girdle.

m. (-तः)
A peacock.
E.
गल the throat, व्रत holy observance; also the same as गरव्रत q. v. ल being substituted for र.

f. (-का)
The uvula or soft palate.
E.
गल the throat, and शुण्डिका the elephant's trunk, resembling it in being a pendulous, roundish, and fleshy substance.

f. (-नी)
A she goat.
E.
गल the throat, and लन the breast; some species of the Bengal goat have small fleshy processes, resembling nipples depending from the throat; also गलेस्तनी.

m. (-स्तः)
Throttling.
E.
गल, and हस्त the hand.

m. (-रः)
A disease of the throat, inflammation of the fauces, and enlargement of the tonsils.
E.
गल the throat, and अङ्कुर a new sprout.

m. (-लः)
A prawn or shrimp: see गङ्गाटेय. Some books read this गलानिल, and others गलानिक.

m. (-लिः)
A strong and lazy ox.
E.
गल to eat, and इन् affix; who is good for nothing but eating.

m. (-लिः)
A curse, execration or imprecation.
E.
गल in the causal form, to cause to drop, and इन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Fallen, dropped.
2 Liquefied, melted.
3 Distilled, oozing, flowing.
4 Decayed, impaired.
5 Lost, deprived.
6 Untied, loosed.
E.
गल to drop, to ooze, affix क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Melted, fused.
2 Strained.
3 Distilled, dropped.
E.
गल to drop, causal form, क्त aff.

n. (-ष्ठं)
Advanced and incurable leprosy, when the fingers and toes fall off.
E.
गलित, and कुष्ठ leprosy.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Toothless.
E.
गलित, and दन्त tooth.

mfn. (-खः-खा-खी-खं)
Having no nails.
E.
गलित, and नख the nail.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Blind.
E.
गलित, and नयन the eye.

m. (-ण्डः)
A kind of bird, (the Adjutant or Ardea argala.)
E.
गल the throat, in the seventh case, and गण्ड a boil; alluding to a pendulous fleshy purse hanging from the throat.

f. (-नी)
A she goat: see गलस्तनी.

m. (-लूः)
A sort of gem.

r. 1st cl. (गल्भते)
To be bold or confident.

mfn. (-ल्भः-ल्भा-ल्भं)
1 Proud, haughty.
2 Confident, bold, audacious.
E.
गल्भ to be proud, &c. अच् affix, more commonly प्रगल्भ.

f. (-ल्या)
1 A multitude of throats.
2 A quantity of a kind of grass, or ropes made of it.
E.
गल a throat, &c. य aff.

f. (-री)
A small round pillow to put underneath the cheek.
E.
गल्ल the cheek, and चातुर a pillow.

m. (-र्कः)
1 A goblet, a vessel for drinking spirituous liquor.
2 Lapis lazuli.
E.
गल to drop, deriv. irr.

r. 1st cl. (गल्हते)
To blame, to censure or despise: see गर्ह.

m. (-वः)
1 A tree, the bark of which is used in dying, Lodh, (Symplocus racemosa, Rox.)
2 A pale species of the same: see लोध्र.
3 A kind of ebony; also केन्दुक, (Diospyros glutinosa.)
4 A particular Muni or saint, a disciple of VIŚVĀMITRA. []
E.
गाल flux, and ब what prevents; referring to the astringent qualities of the Lodh.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
1 Fusing, liquefying.
2 Distilling.
3 Abusive, abusing.
f. (-नी)
A particular gesticulation or Madrā.
E.
गल to flow, causal form, णिनि aff.

n. (-ड्यं)
The seed of the lotus.
